theme_central: The clear Proof (al-bayyina) that should have united the People of the Book and the polytheists around exclusive worship — instead, it definitively separates the best from the worst of creatures.
sources_note: Content widely taught and undisputed, short but structured in 3 clear movements.

branches.title: The clear Proof
branches.resume: Disbelievers and polytheists were not going to cease until the coming of a Messenger reciting purified scrolls.

children.t: A Messenger sent with purified scrolls, the clear Proof

branches.title: The religion of uprightness
branches.resume: Division arose after the Proof was received; a single command: worship Allah exclusively, pray, pay zakat.

children.t: Exclusive worship, prayer and zakat: the religion of uprightness

branches.title: Best and worst of creatures
branches.resume: Disbelievers destined for Hell, worst of creatures; believing doers of good, best of creatures, gardens of Eden.

children.t: Final contrast: worst and best of creatures
